subject: Geopolitics
title: Wartime Censorship
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Wartime Censorship.

hook.text: During World War II, soldiers' letters were read and censored before mailing.

buildup.text: Wartime censorship prevents leaks of troop positions, morale data, and casualties.

discovery.text: Modern wars add a new layer: controlling social media posts by soldiers.

twist.text: Censorship helps the enemy too. When citizens don't know the true cost of war, they can't hold leaders accountable.

climax.text: Wartime censorship is a trade-off: security against transparency. Too much secrecy protects leaders, not soldiers.

punchline.text: Hide the truth to win the war. Hide it well enough to lose the peace.

quiz.question: What is the main trade-off of wartime censorship?
